title: Test case: Monte Carlo estimate offered as the bound

claims.statement: For the LDPC subcode defined by gen.py and belief-propagation decoding with 50 iterations, eps(f, g) <= 3/50 on BSC(1/10) with a uniform message.
For the same code and decoder (50 iterations, no early stop), g executes at most W <= 2^24 operations of the bsc-ops-v1 model on every received word.
